title: Jev decision request v1
description: What Jev is asked for one step (spec section 5.2): structured metadata only, never a token or a prompt to execute.

candidates.description: Runtime ids, the author's preference first.

risk_class.description: read_only, writes or side_effects; anything else stops the decision.

account_provider.description: The provider of the account the step will run under, when the scheduler knows it. An aibus step on an openrouter account needs the same approval as the openrouter runtime. Omitted when unknown.

approved.description: Runtimes the user approved for this run. Only openrouter needs it: it is separately billed and sends the prompt to a third party, so it is never picked without it. Omitted when empty.
